title: Included Services and Workshop Handling under the Belrose Jewelry Protection and Care Plans: Liaison Schedule
content:
The routine services a plan of the Belrose Jewelry Protection and Care Plans includes in a rolling twelve months, the bench work included without a claim, and how the workshop handles a covered piece are fixed per plan in this schedule, which the workshop and the protection desk share.

| | Manufacturer Limited Warranty | Belrose Care Plan 2-Year | Belrose Care Plan 3-Year | Belrose Care Plan 5-Year | Belrose Lifetime Care Plan | Belrose Heirloom Protection Plan |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Rhodium replatings included in a rolling twelve months | 0 | 1 | 1 | 2 | 2 | 4 |
| Ring resizings included in a rolling twelve months | 0 | 1 | 1 | 2 | 2 | 3 |
| Polish-and-refinish services included in a rolling twelve months | 1 | 2 | 2 | 4 | 4 | 6 |
| Chain and solder repairs included without a claim | no | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Clasp replacement included without a claim | no | no | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Loaner piece offered while the covered piece is at the workshop | no | no | no | yes | yes | yes |
| Business days the workshop targets for covered bench work | 21 | 14 | 12 | 10 | 7 | 5 |
| Expedited workshop handling may be requested | no | no | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| An accepted claim goes to the workshop on a bench work order rather than being settled at the counter | yes | yes | yes | yes | no | no |
| Out-of-scope service visits handled as goodwill in a rolling twelve months | 0 | 1 | 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 |

## Notes for the bench

- The included counts are per rolling twelve months and are the plan's own; the Manufacturer Limited Warranty includes one refinish and no replating or resizing.
- The turnaround target is the number of business days the workshop targets for covered bench work on that plan, from 21 on the Manufacturer Limited Warranty down to 5 on the Belrose Heirloom Protection Plan.
- On the Belrose Lifetime Care Plan and the Belrose Heirloom Protection Plan an accepted claim is not required to go to the workshop on a bench work order; on every other plan it is.
